'''Mortification of the Flesh''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] penance where the penitant is physically harmed such as by birching, whipping, or other corporal punishment.

==Examples==
Throughout the series, there have been references to several Aes Sedai who have been taken out to the square in front of [[Tar Valon]] to be birched in public. If the crime is severe enough, stilling will follow.
